svg.title: Dreams function review by game system
svg.desc: 27 of 9551 function names checked. 1540 functions have evidence-backed system assignments; 8011 functions do not. Sections show evidence-backed associations with parts of Dreams. Every cell is a real function. Every section is filled using the same mapped-count area scale, with near-square row rounding. Labels overlay cells; there are no reserved header bands. Green means name checked; amber means reviewed but unresolved; gray means not reviewed. Assignments are incomplete; full system totals and completion are unknown.

g.text: 1,540 functions mapped to parts of Dreams | 27 names checked
